name: libergent
description: Cloudflare Worker app for searching Romanian second-hand marketplaces with direct parsers.

scripts.search:live: LIBERGENT_MOCK_SEARCH=0 LIBERGENT_MOCK_PROVIDER=0 node src/cli.js search --site all --provider auto --pages 1 --pretty
scripts.check: npm run check:cli && npm run test
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.lint:ui:ci: npm --prefix ui ci --include=dev && npm --prefix ui run lint:ci
scripts.deploy: npm run build:ui && npm run verify:ui-auth-config && wrangler deploy
